messages:
morgan: FYI some SCIM jobs started failing right after the KMS alias rotate this morning. Lots of 500s and Decrypt errors in the audit. Anyone oncall?

alex: I'm here. Which alias got rotated? Any quick log paste?

morgan: `alias/redwood-scim` rotated at ~04:10 UTC. Snippet from provisioner: ```
2026-03-24T04:12:08Z ERROR scim.worker tenant=beta corp=redwood KMSDecryptError: InvalidCiphertextException decrypt failed
2026-03-24T04:12:08Z ERROR scim.job id=job_9876 status=500 attempted=1
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: alias rotation completed by infra-ops at 2026-03-24T04:10:17Z (change: d2f4).

irina: Did the rotation include a blob-rewrap phase? Our SCIM provisioner stores envelope-wrapped keys in scim_envelopes and expects rewrap before alias swap.

samir: Common failure modes: alias pointed to new CMK without rewrap OR encryption-context mismatch (we use svc and oidc_sub in context). Also IAM role for rotator might lack rewrap perms.

jess: Alerting noticed a jump in scim 5xx rate and a cluster autoscale. Pagerduty triggered. Starting an incident shorthand.

morgan: I checked rewrap cron logs, found a failure earlier: `rotator: rewrap failed: AccessDeniedException for principal svc-account:provisioner-rotator`. Looks like the rewrap didn't finish.

alex: If rewrap didn't run, fastest remediation is restore alias to previous key. Do we know if old key still Enabled?

irina: Old key is Enabled. We can point alias back. But note: some jobs retried during the short window and may have done partial SCIM state changes. We'll need a reconciliation pass after rollback.

pagerduty-bot: Incident #INC-31415 created and assigned to eng-security.

samir: Before we rollback, grab list of affected tenants: `select tenant_id from scim_audit where timestamp > '2026-03-24T04:09:00Z' and error like '%Decrypt%' limit 1000;` That gives us the scope to reconcile later.

morgan: Running that now. Got ~97 unique tenants. Dumping to /tmp/affected-tenants-1725154321.csv

alex: Rolling alias back now. infra-bot, please apply alias -> old-key-id.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: alias update queued (rollback request d2f4-rollback).

morgan: Rolled alias back at 04:18 UTC. Post-rollback, provisioner logs show retries succeeding for most tenants. However ~22 tenants still have inconsistent SCIM states: jobs show `deprov_pending` but ID absent in external IdP (we returned 404 on GET).

jess: That indicates mid-transaction failure. Some requests may have deleted on IdP side but DB state not updated, or vice versa. I'll start reconciliation: `provisioner reconcile --window '2026-03-24T04:05:00/2026-03-24T04:20:00' --concurrency 8` and watch diffs.

irina: When doing rewrap we must also preserve encryption-context exactly. Check scim_envelopes.wrap_ctx column to ensure it contains keys `svc=provisioner;oidc_sub=svc-provisioner@redwood`. If context changed (we deployed OIDC issuer update last week) it could block decrypt even with correct CMK.

morgan: Query shows wrap_ctx as `svc=provisioner;oidc_sub=svc-provisioner@redwood` across sample rows. No mismatch.

samir: Two follow-ups: 1) rotator role needs explicit kms:Decrypt on old key and kms:Encrypt on new key plus kms:ReEncrypt* if using conditional statements; 2) change rotation playbook to run rewrap fully and verify canary tenant before alias swap. Also add a safety flag: only swap alias if `rewrap_status=complete` and sample decrypts pass.

alex: Agreed. Also we saw the rotator was running a newer KMS SDK (v4.x) while provisioner uses v3.x. Not likely the break but add to vuln/dep triage to ensure no behavioral differences. Create a ticket for dependency alignment.

jess: Recon job found 22 anomalies. For 18 tenants, we could finish deprovision by issuing final DELETE on the IdP and marking job complete. For 4 tenants the external IdP returned 409/conflict — need manual owner review. I'll open SRs for those four.

irina: For long-term: support a two-phase alias switch in runbook: create new key -> test decrypt on new key for canary objects -> run rewrap to migrate blobs -> verify all rewraps succeeded -> run small-scale canary alias swap for subset of services -> monitor -> global alias switch. Also add automated snapshot of scim_audit and scim_envelopes pre-swap so we can reconcile.

morgan: Good. Also add a check in deploy pipeline to fail fast if rewrap job reports AccessDenied. That would have prevented alias pointing to new key without rewrap.

samir: I'll draft IAM least-priv policy for rotator role: kms:Decrypt on old-KMS-arn, kms:Encrypt on new-KMS-arn, kms:ReEncryptFrom/To, kms:DescribeKey. Include condition restricting encryptionContext: {"svc":"provisioner"} if required.

alex: Opening infra ticket INFRA-6291 to patch role perms and update rotation playbook. Jess will include reconciliation steps and runbook tests.

jess: PR created for runbook updates and a small e2e test harness to exercise rewrap on a synthetic tenant.

morgan: Thanks all. I'll follow up with the incident report and a list of affected tenants. If you see any other SCIM 500 windows around 04:10-04:20 UTC please flag them to me. :thumbsup:
